description: Erases what a mask covers with no prompt, filling from the surroundings (remove_object, LaMa). This is the removal route: white mask pixels are erased, the rest comes back unchanged. Suits small to medium objects - a cup, a sign, a watermark; a large region comes back smeared. Raise dilate (16 to 24) for a soft edge or a shadow; use segment-and-remove to mask the object by name instead of drawing one. To put something new in the mask, use a prompted inpainter (models/z-image-inpaint or templates/inpaint) instead.
